text: How to reach SRMIST Kattankulathur: address is SRM Nagar, GST Road, Kattankulathur, Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu 603203. It is about 30 km from Chennai International Airport, about 40 km from Chennai Central railway station and about 35 km from Chennai Mofussil Bus Terminus (Koyambedu). By road take GST Road (local buses from Chennai); by train get off at Potheri/Kattankulathur railway station near the campus and take a local auto or taxi; by air fly into Chennai and take a taxi.

Visiting SRMIST Kattankulathur: visiting hours are 9 AM to 5 PM, Monday to Saturday. Visitor contact numbers: +91-044 27455510 and 044 47437500. Hotels near the campus on GST Road include SRM Hotel, Welcomhotel by ITC and V Five Hotel. A virtual campus tour is at https://webstor.srmist.edu.in/web_assets/srmist-virtual-tour-vo/index.htm and visitor details at https://www.srmist.edu.in/visitors/

Sports facilities at SRMIST: the Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar Aquatic Complex with an international-standard 50-metre swimming pool, two football fields (one turf), two hockey fields, two floodlit synthetic tennis courts, an air-conditioned multipurpose indoor stadium and fitness centres including gyms for hostel students. Outdoor games include cricket, basketball, volleyball and badminton; indoor games include table tennis and shuttle. Professional coaching is available.

Sports at SRMIST: talented athletes can join through sports-quota admission and sports scholarships (exemplary sportspersons at university, district, state, national or international level are eligible for the Founder's Scholarship). The Directorate of Sports runs structured training programmes and sends teams to national and international competitions. Page: https://www.srmist.edu.in/sports/

Hostel rules at SRMIST: you must apply online and sign an online undertaking to follow hostel rules; nobody may stay without formal admission. Fees include admission fee, room rent, amenities, electricity and mess, and are paid in full at admission (part payments are discouraged). Room allotment is by an automated online procedure. Food is served in the mess only and may not be taken to rooms; wasting food can lead to fines. Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited on campus, and students must carry ID cards at all times.

Hostel refund, guests and fines: hostel fees once paid are generally non-refundable; a first-year student who withdraws before the programme starts can get a refund minus a Rs. 5,000 cancellation fee, and after the programme starts room rent and mess fees for completed months are charged. Day scholars and relatives cannot stay in the hostel as guests (parents can request short-term guest accommodation with prior notice and charges). Fines must be paid within one month or the student must vacate. Maintenance complaints go in the complaint register at the entrance of each hostel block. Students vacate during summer breaks except for approved academic reasons.

Campus life at SRMIST Kattankulathur: major Indian festivals are celebrated on campus; students can join NSS, NCC and YRC (Youth Red Cross), cultural and technical clubs, and a Robotics Club that runs workshops and competitions. The campus has several food courts, banks and ATMs, campus-wide Wi-Fi, a health centre with 24-hour emergency services, and counselling for career guidance and personal issues. Cycling and walking are common ways to get around the campus.
